scope: Local synthetic deployment; this is engineering evidence, not production certification
positive_controls: uploaded text has no tool access

blockers.detail: No production identity, role or tenant authorization layer is implemented.
TLS termination and managed certificates are deployment responsibilities and are not configured here.
Development Compose uses demo credentials; production must use an external secret provider.
No production rate limiting or abuse controls are implemented.
Restore drills, database backups, failover and multi-instance coordination have not been validated.
Independent dependency scanning and penetration testing remain external activities.

limitations: Load probe covers read endpoints and deterministic Ask audit writes on one local host
No destructive, stress-to-failure or internet-facing test was performed
